title: $34.3 Million Marble Torso Sets Roman Antiquity Record at Sotheby’s
summary: A marble sculpture fragment depicting the cuirass-clad torso of a Roman emperor hammered for $34.3 million at Sotheby’s on October 21, nearly three times its $12 million estimate and the highest amount ever fetched by a Roman antiquity at auction. title: New York Public Library Acquires Collection of Kiki Smith Prints
summary: Seton Smith, the sister of artist Kiki Smith, has given more than 250 prints made by Kiki to the New York Public Library (NYPL) and has pledged to make a gift of any future prints from her sister to the library. title: A New South Asian Arts Festival Comes To London
summary: London will have a new South Asian arts festival. The nine-day event will take place in South Kensington’s cultural quarter next summer, featuring artists from India and its diaspora. title: Florida Heat Melts Metal Statue of Ron DeSantis
summary: A life-size metal statue of Florida governor Ron DeSantis was unveiled in the state capital of Tallahassee last week and immediately began to melt, The Guardian reports, revealing a skull behind the politician’s face. The project was organized by environmental activists seeking to highlight the Republican leader’s sustained efforts to end or block climate-change protections. […]

summary: The far-right government in Colombia removed more than 30 works from the permanent displays of the Museo Nacional de Colombia in Bogotá, citing “political indoctrination.” The works removed included dozens of objects related to LGBTQ rights and feminism.
